messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Exhaustive branch-and-bound over triangulation combinatorics

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square is uniquely realized by placing 4 points at the corners and 9 points on a 3×3 interior grid at coordinates (i/4, j/4) for i,j ∈ {1,2,3}, yielding a minimum triangle area of 1/32, and exhaustive branch-and-bound over all triangulation combinatorics proves no configuration exceeds this bound because every triangulation of 13 points in the square contains at least one triangle of area ≤ 1/32."}
